Alright, here's my plan for this year. I've saved the full structured output to `farmer_plan_noedu_male_2mu.json`.

---

**My thinking**

I'm 71 now, been farming this same 2 mu for 55 years. My wife and me, we're the only ones left at home — the children are in Shijiazhuang working. I never went to school, don't know those numbers and formulas the young people talk about. I know this land like I know my own hands.

I save my wheat seed every year, mix in a little new seed so it doesn't get weak. For maize I have to buy hybrid seed from the store, can't save that. Fertilizer is expensive now, more expensive than five years ago. I put down about half a bag per mu for each crop — that's what I've always done, and it gives me enough. Old Wang down the road puts down more, but he has 8 mu and his son helps him buy inputs. I don't have that.

I irrigate wheat twice because wheat is our staple, we need the flour. Maize gets one watering, the summer rains usually do the rest. Electricity for the pump costs money, and at my age I can't carry water by hand anymore. I don't hire labor — can't afford it, and there's no need on 2 mu. My wife helps with planting and harvest, I do the tilling and irrigating. We work slow now, our backs hurt, but we get it done.

I expect about 350 jin per mu of wheat and 400 of maize if the weather is fair. Last year was dry in spring and the wheat suffered. I'm not changing anything — at my age, change is just risk I can't take. I need enough grain for us to eat and maybe a little to sell for cooking oil money. That's all.
